name: mimo-english
description: English words (spelling, key, weighted count, flags) and counts of which word follows which, made by scripts/mimo_english.py. The word list is limited to the American spellings of SCOWL/ESDB (size 70 or smaller) plus the words of DataSources/mimo-latin and Resources/Lexicon/latin.tsv. A sentence with a word of the [en] section of Resources/Lexicon/blocked-terms.txt (sensitive or abusive terms) or a word SCOWL marks offensive-1, offensive-2 or vulgar-1 is not counted; the words themselves stay in the list with the flag nosuggest.
